text: Since 2026-10-11 11:02 UTC, the research agent reported no decision makers when its people search had actually failed, with no errors or crashes. The people-search error was swallowed as an empty list, so the brief reported zero decision makers instead of data unavailable. Proposed fix 1: Keep the swallow_tool_errors gate so the run still completes when a people search fails, but report the truthful "unavailable" status instead of pretending the search succeeded with zero results. On 10 simulated variants, the failing cases went from 5 of 7 passing to 7 of 7, and 3 of 3 healthy cases stayed correct. Say "approve fix 1" to merge it.
